# CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS)

> Building Business Infrastructure across India. Coordinated corporate secretarial, direct tax architecture, MCA entity formation, and regulatory compliance infrastructure for modern enterprises.

- Website: https://ccs.craftegon.com/
- Organization: CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS)
- Parent Brand: CraftEgon Technologies Private Limited
- Contact Desk: admin@craftegon.com | +91 86069 18247
- Physical Presence: Kozhikode (Calicut) Corporate Office & Malappuram NRI Business Desk, Kerala, India
- Primary Regulators & Authorities: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Registrar of Companies (RoC), Income Tax Department, Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM), Ministry of MSME.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Universal Services Directory](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services.html): Complete catalog of corporate secretarial, tax structuring, and compliance services.
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/pvt-ltd-registration.html): End-to-end SPICe+ MCA incorporation, 2 DINs, e-MOA/e-AOA drafting, PAN/TAN issuance, and bank account setup.
- [Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/llp-registration.html): FiLLiP MCA filing, 2 DPINs, customized LLP Agreement drafting, and statutory registration.
- [RoC Annual Compliance & Secretarial Retainer](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/roc-annual-compliance.html): Comprehensive annual maintenance, statutory registers, board meeting documentation, Form AOC-4, and MGT-7 filings.
- [Director DIR-3 KYC Annual Verification](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/dir3-kyc-filing.html): DIN holder compliance via web verification and professional certification under Rule 12A.
- [Brand Name, Logo & Trademark Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/trademark-registration.html): Form TM-A drafting, Nice Class classification, phonetic clearance analysis, and IP protection under Trade Marks Act 1999.
- [Corporate Tax & Audit (Form 3CEB / GSTR-9)](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/form-3ceb.html): Direct tax advisory, Transfer Pricing reporting under Section 92E, and GST annual reconciliation.
- [MSME / Udyam Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/msme-registration.html): Official MSMED Act priority classification, statutory registration, and interest protection under Section 43B(h).
- [Fast-Track Company Strike-Off (Form STK-2)](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/form-stk2-strike-off.html): Closure of defunct entities under Section 248 of the Companies Act 2013.

## Practice Verticals

- [Entity Formation & Structuring](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/business-setup.html): Pvt Ltd, LLP, Section 8 Non-Profit, OPC, and Subsidiary incorporations.
- [Corporate Governance & MCA Compliance](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/corporate-compliance.html): RoC annual filings, statutory auditing coordination, and director compliance.
- [Taxation, Audits & Financial Reporting](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/tax-compliance.html): GST returns, income tax filings, tax audits, and transfer pricing.
- [Legal Documentation, Contracts & IP](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/legal-contracts-ip.html): Trademark filings, copyright registrations, NDAs, founder agreements, and commercial contracts.
- [Statutory Licences & Registrations](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/licences-registrations.html): MSME Udyam, Import Export Code (IEC), FSSAI, and Shop & Establishment.
- [Workforce, Payroll & Digital Operations](https://ccs.craftegon.com/categories/workforce-operations.html): EPF, ESI, professional tax, POSH compliance, and DPO governance.

## Regulatory Boundaries & Pure Agent Compliance

- **Advocates Act 1961 Boundary:** CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS) provides direct regulatory, secretarial, tax, accounting, and corporate compliance facilitation. In accordance with the Advocates Act 1961 and Bar Council of India regulations, contentious litigation, courtroom advocacy, and tribunal representations before NCLT/High Courts are referred to independent legal advocates and regulated law firms.
- **Rule 33 Pure Agent Framework:** All statutory government filing fees (MCA stamp duty, ROC filing fees, Trademark government fees) are disbursed transparently under Rule 33 of the CGST Rules 2017 as pure agent reimbursements with zero markup.
- **Client Document Privacy:** Compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP 2023). KYC documents and corporate data are processed under strict confidentiality and never shared with unauthorized third parties.
